messages:
ashley_pm: Heads-up — proposing a slim canary rollout for the regional fallback work. Goal: validate latency/cost impact + correctness of fallback without wide exposure. Posting a concise plan, need eng + SRE + DevEx signoff.

sam_eng: tl;dr of the plan? percent, regions, duration?

ashley_pm: plan sketch:
- Canary percent: 1% traffic initially (increase if stable)
- Regions: start in a single warm region (us-west-2) then add eu-west-1 after 24h
- Duration: 24h baseline, extend to 72h for multi-region stage
- Gates: p50 latency, error rate, and sample-quality checks (small eval set)
- Fallback: immediate global rollback if error_rate > 0.5% or p50 > +150ms vs baseline

liam_sre: sounds reasonable. Who owns the kill-switch? Also we need a runbook snippet and an automatic rollback hook.

ashley_pm: ownership: eng on-call owns immediate rollback, SRE owns automated triggers and postmortem if rollback fires. We will wire a flag-level kill-switch and a global button in shiproom.

devex_zoe: SDK/flag note — please use flag name: feature.regional_fallback.slim_canary and a tenant opt-out flag feature.regional_fallback.tenant_exempt. Also add a client-side short-circuit (server-side first, but client guard useful for beta customers).

sam_eng: can we get the exact gating thresholds in code form so ops can embed in monitors?

ashley_pm: added a tiny config snippet to copy into monitors/alerting: 
```
canary:
  percent: 1
  regions: ["us-west-2"]
  duration: 24h
  gates:
    - name: p50_latency_delta
      threshold_ms: 150
    - name: error_rate
      threshold_pct: 0.5
    - name: quality_regression
      sample_eval: "smoke-prompts-v2"
```

liam_sre: perfect. I'll add the alert rules and a dashboard tile. For rollback automation: recommend a 3-strike rule (3 consecutive 5m windows breaching) before automated global rollback, to avoid flapping. Manual rollback is immediate.

ashley_pm: agree on 3-strike. We also need an annotated rollout table for customer ops: who gets canary traffic and whether tenants can opt-in/out. suggest default opt-in for all eligible tenants, but allow sales-provisioned opt-out.

devex_zoe: opt-in semantics: 1) global default on, 2) tenant_exempt list, 3) per-route override in SDK. I'll draft the doc. Also let's tag the feature in the console under "canaries -> slim" so it shows up in rollout UI.

sam_eng: quick question about AB testing: do we want to run an A/B comparing fallback hits vs direct reroute? Might help quantify quality delta.

ashley_pm: yes — run an A/B subset inside the canary cohort: 50/50 fallback vs current behavior for that 1% bucket. Metrics: token-level cost, median latency, and a tiny user-quality eval. Keep it internal only for the canary.

liam_sre: telemetry checklist: add trace IDs on fallback path, log a short reason code, and sample full requests for 0.1% to S3 for offline eval. I'll wire that.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: note registered. CI job: canary-deploy/regional-fallback v2 queued by @ashley_pm. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/1728509999

devex_zoe: can everyone give thumbs within 2 business hours? I want to align SDK + console updates before we open the canary. :thumbsup:

sam_eng: +1

liam_sre: +1

ashley_pm: thanks — I'll update the rollout doc and create the shiproom ticket with the runbook and the rollback command. If anything changes ping here. :rocket:
